sections.eligibility: Non-farm small/micro businesses (shops, trading, services, manufacturing) needing credit up to the Mudra ceiling. No collateral required. Available from banks, NBFCs and MFIs.
sections.benefits: Collateral-free loans in tiers: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh). Check the official site for any newer higher tier.
sections.documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar), address proof, business proof or Udyam registration where available, recent bank statements, passport photos.
sections.how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch, NBFC or MFI, or through the Udyamimitra portal. Bring ledger/bank records showing regular business income.

sections.eligibility: Street vendors with a Certificate of Vending / ID card or a letter of recommendation from the urban local body, operating in urban areas.
sections.benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan in tranches with repayment-linked higher limits, interest subsidy for regular repayment and cashback for digital transactions. Verify the current tranche amounts on the official portal.
sections.documents: Vending certificate / ULB letter of recommendation, Aadhaar, bank account, mobile number linked to Aadhaar.
sections.how_to_apply: Apply via the PM SVANidhi portal or app, or through a Common Service Centre.

sections.eligibility: New and existing micro and small enterprises (manufacturing or services; retail trade eligibility has varied, so verify) borrowing from member lending institutions.
sections.benefits: Government-backed guarantee so banks can lend without collateral or third-party guarantee up to the scheme ceiling.
sections.documents: Udyam registration, KYC, project/business details, financial statements or bank statements.
sections.how_to_apply: Apply to a member bank/NBFC; the lender enrols the loan under the guarantee.

sections.eligibility: Individuals above 18 starting a NEW micro-enterprise. Not for existing units. Minimum education may apply for higher project costs.
sections.benefits: Credit-linked margin-money subsidy on project cost; rate depends on category and urban/rural location.
sections.documents: Project report, identity and address proof, caste/special category certificate if applicable, EDP training certificate.
sections.how_to_apply: Apply online on the PMEGP e-portal; processed by KVIC / KVIB / DIC and a partner bank.

sections.eligibility: Any micro, small or medium enterprise. Free, paperless, based on Aadhaar and PAN/GSTIN details as applicable.
sections.benefits: Unlocks priority-sector lending, CGTMSE cover, subsidies and many scheme applications. Treat this as the first step before most credit schemes.
sections.documents: Aadhaar of proprietor, PAN (and GSTIN if applicable), bank account details, business activity details.
sections.how_to_apply: Register for free on the official Udyam portal; no fee is charged.
